notes.title: Update Notes Playtest Version 1.0.6
notes.content:
Update Notes Playtest Version 1.0.6



The following new selectable option is now available based on a community suggestion.



UI / Gamesettings:

Added a new selectable option for Crosshair:: " None+Hitindicator "

(If you want to play without an visible crosshair, you can now see, in case you missed the target, how far away the last shoot was)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695796/73df7338cf405b162068eaa31d143ef431c8d1a5.png"]

notes.title: Update Notes Playtest v. 1.0.5
notes.content:
Update Notes Playtest v. 1.0.5

Fixes::

System message "ray tracing geometry over budget" should not apear any longer


Changes::

Weapons balancing::
Rifle -> Damage increased, Ammo increased (+1 Bullet), Reload speed slightly increased

Enemies:
Size increased (available as selectable option: Arcade/Standard)

UI / Gamesettings:
Added selectable option within Gamesettings menu. Arcade and Standart sized enemies.
(As this is experimental at the moment, it only effects Level 1 for testing purposes first)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45695796/08567f6c87d0bcc27af3ddd3ae2a9770bbfb78ab.png"]

notes.title: Hotfix #1 Playtest v. 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,
[p align="start"]Hotfix #1 is out for the current Playtest v. 1.0.4
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Fixed:
[p align="start"]- Graveyard level: Common Zombie enemies are now stopping as intended after taking damage.

notes.title: Update Notes Playtest v. 1.0.3
notes.content:
Whats new?

 New graveyard level added
 Difficulty selection (Normal/Hard) is now activated
 Challenges are now activated


Bugfixes::
Automatic weapon do not longer keep shooting after pressing "continue"

Notes::
Most of the used enemies are archetypes, variety will be increased in later versions.
The Challenges are different for each difficulty.
